selection_status: Canonical-D v3. The shared-alpha baseline remains the v2 active-three-weight-renormalized implementation. The proposed separate-alpha lateral branch applies an archived-VLM path-wise curvature gain after the unchanged geometric curvature normalization.

experiment.risk_scale_policy: The v3 VLM curvature gain changes only the proposed separate-alpha lateral-risk construction. CTG, MPC, LQR, RL checkpoint/filter/guard, R_th, k, path reference, and archived VLM artifact remain fixed.

risk.separate_lateral_vlm_gain_reference: max_q(w_kappa^(q)) over archived path1/path2/path3 VLM weights
risk.renormalization_scope: Shared baseline: active {d,v,kappa} weights are renormalized. Proposed longitudinal branch: raw archived w_d,w_v are renormalized over {d,v}. Proposed lateral branch: archived w_kappa is normalized by the maximum archived path-wise w_kappa after the unchanged geometric curvature normalization.
risk.distance_scale_rationale: d_safe_m=15 m yields R_d=0.5 at a 30 m bumper gap, close to the CTG reference gap at the 15 m/s baseline speed.
